value.rationale: The complete defect distribution of all classically optimal colourings answers a natural exact stability problem for a stricter neighbourhood colouring constraint. It exposes an unavoidable quadratic obstruction and a separate three-vertex tournament-source correction, gives exact frequencies and a sharp one-colour surcharge on an infinite classical graph family.
